name: Working On The Sabbath
overview: Scripture clearly commands the observance of the Sabbath as a holy day of rest dedicated to the LORD, emphasizing that no work is to be done by anyone within the community, including servants and even animals (Exodus 20:8,10; Leviticus 23:3). The seriousness of this command is underscored by the warning of death for those who work on the Sabbath (Exodus 35:2) and includes refraining from activities such as kindling fire (Exodus 35:3). Yet, Jesus highlights compassionate exceptions by illustrating that acts of mercy, like rescuing a sheep in distress, are consistent with the Sabbath’s intent (Matthew 12:11).
